dependencyDirectionCheck.rule: AIBT.Editor depends on AIBT.Authoring/AIBT.Runtime; neither depends back on AIBT.Editor
dependencyDirectionCheck.evidence: AIBT.Runtime.asmdef references only Unity.Burst/Unity.Collections; AIBT.Authoring.asmdef references only AIBT.Runtime/Newtonsoft.Json -- neither lists AIBT.Editor. Unchanged from P4-GATE: Phase 5's new Editor/HotReload/ and Authoring/HotReload/ files live inside these same three existing asmdefs, no new production asmdef reference was added.

editorScopedForbiddenTokenAudit.note: using UnityEditor is expected and allowed in Editor/; only Entities/MCP/LLM tokens are forbidden there too

note: Phase 5's own benchmark harness (Benchmarks~/Phase5/HotReload/Unity/{Runtime,Editor}/*.asmdef) is intentionally excluded from this audit: the Benchmarks~/ tilde suffix hides it from Unity's asset database entirely, matching every prior phase's benchmark folders (Benchmarks~/Phase2, Phase4) -- it is not part of the shipped package's production assembly surface.
